This was manually corrected after investigation (see packages/cli/src/discovery/search.ts scoreFile and boundary.ts detectRiskGates) to match the tight scope explicitly stated in spec.md's Constraints section: web/app/page.tsx plus an optional new web/lib/filter.ts helper only. web/lib/store.ts and web/lib/types.ts were real, correctly-discovered candidates but are moved to read-only context since spec AC-05 requires no persistence/type changes.
